_what: RESULTS of the Blendkit month — the slots qa/blenderkit-month-classes.json declares are 'filled IN ORDER', moved here so that FILLING them cannot edit the file the criteria digest protects. The criteria file stays byte-frozen; this file is never hashed. See the RESULTS comment in pipeline/scripts/blenderkit.py for the probe that forced the split.
_law: A class in `classes` below is only C2 evidence if it is ALSO pre-registered in qa/blenderkit-month-classes.json. Anything else is OUT-OF-TEST: shopped for on the owner's ask, reported honestly, and explicitly not counted toward 'did the paid month make the work better'. Adding a class to the frozen file after seeing results is the flattering-scorer move the freeze exists to catch, and it still flips the digest to CHANGED if anyone does it.
_reading_order: free_baseline is recorded BEFORE the first paid fetch in that class (the pass rule in the criteria file); paid_result after.
